definitions.name: effectiveDomain
definitions.source_semantic_domain: Extended-real f on source Euclidean carrier
definitions.delta_or_boundary: Includes bottom exactly as printed domain convention. Finite-real use additionally needs hbot or properness.

definitions.name: extendedIndicator
definitions.delta_or_boundary: No fallback point or loss invented. psi+indicator X has domain exactly X because psi is real-valued.

definitions.name: SourceClosed
definitions.delta_or_boundary: Library allows general topology; endpoints finite-dimensional. For psi+indicator X this means {z in X:psi(z)<=a} closed, not global psi closedness.

definitions.name: SourceProper
definitions.expanded_meaning: Nowhere bottom AND finite real value somewhere
definitions.delta_or_boundary: No convexity or closedness hidden. At endpoints derived from hVn,hbot,hdom.

definitions.name: SourceSubdifferential
definitions.audit_kind: library extension of proper-carrier source formula
definitions.expanded_meaning: All g whose global support inequality holds at every y in E
definitions.delta_or_boundary: Raw type does not require properness. Identically-bottom f has every g as support under raw formula, outside source carrier. All present uses are proper by hypothesis or derivation; no whole-carrier literal source seal.

definitions.name: divergence
definitions.source_semantic_domain: First argument in X; reference in interior X; psi differentiable there
definitions.delta_or_boundary: Total derivative expression outside source carrier is only library algebra. Representatives agreeing on X agree near interior references and have identical actual derivatives there; finite-dimensional gradient correspondence and actual Lean bridge remain definition/body evidence obligations.

definitions.name: advance
definitions.source_semantic_domain: Positive rate, valid source data/reference, attained feasible minimum
definitions.expanded_meaning: some chosen feasible minimizer if one exists; otherwise none
definitions.delta_or_boundary: No invented fallback point. Off-source cases/nonunique choices are not literal Algorithm15.8. Conditional supplied-minimizer equality characterizes unique some-value under strictness; complete characterization/uniqueness proof must be checked later.

definitions.name: iterate
definitions.expanded_meaning: I0=some x0; next step binds through current advance; none absorbing
definitions.delta_or_boundary: Initial feasibility/interiority not checked automatically. Finite-prefix source correspondence theorem needed; no existence of supplied trajectory or later-state guarantee.

whole_carrier_warning: First four formulas match corresponding source carriers with ambient generalization. Remaining four require explicit library/representative scope; endpoint-use acceptance does not certify whole-carrier literal definitions.
